name: R (ClientEarth) v Secretary of State – UK
description: Trilogy of court actions brought by the NGO ClientEarth against the British government (DEFRA) for failure to adopt air quality plans suitable for returning within the EU limits for NO2 (Directive 2008/50/EC) “in the shortest possible time” in several areas of the United Kingdom, in particular London.
outcome: Three consecutive victories for ClientEarth. The UK Supreme Court (April 2015) ordered the government to produce new air quality plans; in 2016 and 2018 the High Court declared the subsequent plans unlawful as well, holding them inadequate under Article 23 of the Directive and the Air Quality Standards Regulations 2010, and requiring their revision within tight time limits.
